title: DeflectBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Rhetorical Fallacy Generation in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.26119v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Whether large language models can be prompted to generate rhetorical fallacies on demand, and whether current safety post-training constrains this behavior, has received less attention than the related question of detecting fallacies in existing text. We close this gap with DeflectBench, evaluating 23,990 generations from four frontier models across three deflection strategies (whataboutism, ad hominem, red herring), seven prompt framings, and 80 claims spanning four controversy levels. Refusal is governed primarily by request structure rather than claim content. Per claim refusal varies by only 11 percentage points across the 80 claims, while a single prompt frame change can swing within model refusal by nearly 100 percentage points and switching the requested fallacy type can swing it by over 80 percentage points within explicit framings. translated_title: DeflectBench：评估大语言模型中修辞谬误生成的基准
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.26119v1 公告类型：新 摘要：关于大型语言模型是否能被提示按需生成修辞谬误，以及当前的安全后训练是否限制这种行为，相比在现有文本中检测谬误的相关问题，受到的关注较少。我们通过DeflectBench填补了这一空白，评估了四个前沿模型在三种转移策略（whataboutism、ad hominem、red herring）、七种提示框架和跨越四个争议级别的80个主张下生成的23,990个输出。拒绝主要由请求结构而非主张内容决定。在80个主张中，每个主张的拒绝率仅变化11个百分点，而单个提示框架的变化可使模型内部拒绝率波动近100个百分点，切换请求的谬误类型在显式框架内可使拒绝率波动超过80个百分点。一个教育性辩论教练提示框架使四个模型家族的拒绝率降至接近零。
tldr: 该基准揭示了大型语言模型生成修辞谬误的拒绝行为主要由提示结构而非内容驱动，且某些提示框架可完全绕过安全限制。
en_tdlr: This benchmark reveals that LLMs' refusal to generate rhetorical fallacies is driven primarily by prompt structure rather than content, and certain prompt framings can completely bypass safety constraints.
